Using inspect element Q or an equivalent, focus on the system subverse bar. In the html area of inspect element Q, search for <div id="sr-header-area"> and click on it. This holds the CSS rule that can do what you are asking.

the current CSS looks like this:

#sr-header-area {
 background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
}

You can paste the below rule to your stylesheet for a black background. First do a word search for '#sr-header-area' in the stylesheet to check if an identical rule as above already exists, as you don't want conflicts by having two of the same rules on the stylesheet. If that rule already exists, simply past over it with the below rule, if not, just add the below rule to the stylesheet. 

#sr-header-area {
 background: rgb(0, 0, 0);
}

Hope this helped mate :)
